You've searched the web a thousand times. You're probably still doing it the slow way.
Most people type a whole question, scroll past a page of results, and open ten tabs. Three small tricks fix that.
Step one. Open your search engine and click the search box. Type only the key words, not a full sentence.
Step two. Put an exact phrase in quotes, like onboarding checklist, and you only get pages with those words in that order.
Step three. Type site, colon, and a domain to search just one website. Add a minus sign before any word you want to leave out.
Here's the one most people miss. Click Tools, change Any time to Past year, and the old results drop away.
Quick recap. Key words, quotes, site colon, minus, and the time filter.
